tasks.title: Removing a deck: delete its cards, move them to another deck, or only when empty?
tasks.description:
🟡 #46 · Removing a deck: what happens to its cards?

Coral's rec: Only when empty, plus a "move all cards to…" step that asks which deck. No card is deleted by removing a deck, and none lands in a deck you didn't choose. I'd add "Delete deck" to the long-press menu, shown when the deck is empty.

tasks.title: Deck into a card: into an existing card, a new card, or both?
tasks.description:
